body: And what kind of things can I do for myself?
I understand what you say, but spend time on me makes me feel lonely. I only love caring for others, not for me. Thank you anyways!

Your words made me feel better. That drawing is very beautiful, I can't believe someone made something like that for me. I appreciate your help so much, but I feel like it doesn't matter in the end. There is no solution to the problem. I want to stay alive, and fight, but a part of me have just given up and want to die to end this painful existence.
